summary: Tested the uploaded-logo propagation flow (CMS Site Settings -> public /api/public/company -> public header/footer ). Backend side works perfectly (4/4 pytest). Frontend upload+save works and the DB is updated (GET /api/public/company returns logo_url). HOWEVER, the public website STILL does NOT render the uploaded logo - it keeps showing the default SVG 'R' monogram. Root cause is a guard clause in PublicLayout.jsx that only merges /public/company into state when response has a non-empty `name` field; since site_settings has no `name` filled in a fresh DB, logo_url is dropped on the floor. This directly reproduces the user's complaint ('logo upload tapi di website tidak terupdate').

minor.issue: Fallback to doc_assets brand.logo_file_id is gated by `if out and not ...`; when settings.company_info document is absent entirely (out == {}), fallback is skipped. Low priority (user already created settings), but inconsistent with the design intent.

ui_bugs.issue: Guard `if (r.data && r.data.name) setCompany(...)` prevents applying API response when `name` is empty. Fresh DB has company_info only populated with logo_url -> company.logo_url is never set in state -> renders SVG monogram instead of .

integration_issues.flow: CMS logo upload -> public header/footer render
integration_issues.issue: Backend persists logo_url and /api/public/company returns it (verified: `{logo_url: '/api/public/media/med_de8497ae9caf49d9', site_url: ''}`), but the public layout never applies it due to the frontend `name` guard. End-to-end fix is incomplete.

action_items: Fix PublicLayout.jsx: remove the `&& r.data.name` guard (or change to `if (r.data) setCompany(c => ({...c, ...r.data}))`), so uploaded logo_url (and any other field) propagates even when name is empty. This is THE blocker for the user's report.
Optional: in backend/routers/public.py `public_company()`, drop the `if out and` prefix so the doc_assets brand fallback also runs when settings.company_info is entirely absent.
critical_code_review_comments: PublicLayout.jsx `name`-only guard silently discards all other legitimate company fields (logo_url, phone, email, socials...). It should merge unconditionally once r.data is an object.
Backend public_company fallback should trigger whenever logo_url missing, independent of whether other settings exist.

success_rate.frontend: 50% (upload UI + save work; public rendering of uploaded logo fails)

The remaining UI bug reproduces by just loading '/' - look at brand-logo wrapper: it still contains . After fix, verify by GET /api/public/company returning logo_url AND the public homepage showing twice (header+footer) with naturalWidth>0.
rca of the issue: User-visible symptom: 'logo yang diupload tidak muncul di website'. The CMS flow correctly uploads via POST /api/uploads/cms and saves logo_url via PUT /api/site/settings. The backend GET /api/public/company returns the logo_url. BUT PublicLayout.jsx (`PublicShell` component, line 113) only applies the response when `r.data.name` is truthy: `if (r.data && r.data.name) setCompany((c) => ({ ...c, ...r.data }))`. Fresh DB has no name set, so the whole merge is skipped, company.logo_url stays undefined, and <Logo logoUrl={company.logo_url}> falls into the SVG-monogram branch. Mitigation: drop the `.name` guard; the `useResource/useEffect` can safely merge any object returned.
